verdict.rationale: Password-protecting a deployed site is a fair question for a hosting platform like Fly.io, but the evidence pack shows no built-in feature for basic auth or password-gating a site. Secrets storage and per-Sprite service access grants are adjacent building blocks, not site password protection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system
